title: PoRobotTrain
tagline: A Unitree R1 humanoid digital twin: train in MuJoCo, rehearse in Unreal Engine 5, run the same policy on the real robot.
intro: PoRobotTrain trains behaviours for a Unitree R1 EDU humanoid (26 motors) with reinforcement learning in MuJoCo, rehearses them in an Unreal Engine 5 digital twin that runs MuJoCo inside the engine, then runs the same ONNX file and the same controller code on the real robot through Unitree SDK2.

It starts trivially safe and grows level by level. Level 0 hangs the robot on its stand and moves only the head and one arm; a behaviour panel in the twin moves the virtual robot first and only then unlocks a read-only connection check and the real robot.
facts: Unreal Engine 5.8 + MuJoCo 4.0.0 (URLab plugin); Chaos is off
PPO, 50 Hz, ONNX run with Unreal NNE in the twin and onnxruntime on the robot
A 20 s sweep in Unreal and in headless MuJoCo differ by at most 0.37 deg per joint
Stand-mounted Level 0, virtual run first, emergency stop on the remote
